message.content:
An editorial illustration features two large, yellow and green excavators facing each other. Their long booms extend upward, meeting at the top. The buckets of these machines are positioned to grasp a green sphere adorned with white stars and a globe design. Each excavator has a small cabin occupied by a seated person wearing a light-colored shirt and a dark cap. The figures are seen from the side, grasping control levers. Small, dark, blocky debris falls through the air between the two machines.

The background consists of light green and yellowish-tan horizontal bands. At the bottom, dark tracks of the excavators sit on a green surface. Large black text in the center reads "BARA TAMBANG ELITE NAHDLIYIN," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Pembesar Nahdlatul Ulama." The word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters across the top, partially obscured by the excavator arms. Other text includes "Korupsi Pajak Bidikan Jaksa H.60," "Skenario Garuda Mengakuisisi Pelita H.70," and a date of "1-7 DESEMBER 2025." A barcode and QR code are in the bottom left corner.
